title: The Go SDK against Cloud and Branch Connector (ZTW): where its behavior is described

prose.text: Package and function tables are generated: run `node scripts/kb.mjs surface ztw` for each Go package's exported functions and the endpoints they call. These subjects hold the client behavior around them; the API itself is in [[cloud-connector.api]].

prose.label: Reaching the API.
prose.text: OneAPI routing, the legacy client and its ZTC_* settings are in [[cloud-connector.api.authentication]]; client-side rate limits in [[cloud-connector.api.rate-limits]]; government clouds in [[cloud-connector.terraform.provider-config]].

prose.label: Reading.
prose.text: Paging and early stops are in [[shared.sdk-go.list-pagination]]; name lookups and JMESPath filtering in [[cloud-connector.sdk-go.lookups]].

prose.label: Writing.
prose.text: Request and response handling is in [[shared.sdk-go.request-handling]], omitted zero values in [[shared.sdk-go.zero-value-writes]], retries in [[shared.sdk-go.retries]], and ZTW service defects (legacy misrouting, unchecked assertions) in [[cloud-connector.sdk-go.service-defects]].

prose.label: Gaps in coverage.
prose.text: Commented-out functions, activation, connector-group operations and missing fields are in [[cloud-connector.sdk-go.coverage]]; the activate calls themselves in [[shared.activation.cbc]].
